items.name: No disclosed backlog
items.claim: Amkor discloses its absence of backlog and the short-term nature of its customers' commitments as a risk factor in its own earnings release.

searched.result: No dollar backlog, RPO, or named contract/award figure found; the release itself states Amkor carries no meaningful backlog because customer commitments are short-term.

notes: Amkor is an OSAT (outsourced semiconductor assembly and test) provider whose own disclosure states it does not maintain a meaningful backlog given the short-term nature of customer commitments; this is itself the disclosed answer on the BACKLOG axis, recorded with value/currency null.
